name: Nintedanib
indications_original: Nintedanib is a kinase inhibitor indicated in adultsfor: Treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF). ( 1.1 ) Treatment of chronic fibrosing interstitial lung diseases (ILDs) with a progressive phenotype. ( 1.2 )
contraindications_original: Recommended dosage: 150 mg taken orally twice daily approximately 12 hours apart taken with food. ( 2.2 ) Recommended dosage in patients with mild hepatic impairment (Child Pugh A): 100 mg taken orally twice daily approximately 12 hours apart taken with food. ( 2.3 , 8.6 ) Consider temporary dose reduction to 100 mg, treatment interruption, or discontinuation for management of adverse reactions. ( 2.4 , 5.2 , 5.3 , 6 ) Prior to treatment initiation, conduct liver function tests in all patients and a pregnancy test in females of reproductive potential. ( 2.1 , 5.2 , 5.4 )
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
150 mg: brown coloured, opaque, oblong, soft gelatin capsules imprinted with “150” in black ink. Free from physical defects. They are packaged in HDPE bottles with a child-resistant closure, available as follows: 
                   Bottles of 60 NDC: 43598-147-60 
                  100 mg: peach coloured, opaque, oblong, soft gelatin capsules imprinted with “100” in black ink. Free from physical defects. They are packaged in HDPE bottles with a child-resistant closure, available as follows: 
                  Bottles of 60 NDC: 43598-148-60 
                  
                     Storage
                  
                  Store at 20°C to 25°C (68°F to 77°F); excursions permitted to 15°C to 30°C (59°F to 86°F) [see USPControlled Room Temperature]. Protect from exposure to high humidity and avoid excessive heat. If repackaged, use USP tight container.
